synopsis: Siemens crane twins feature as vendor evidence for Mevea and contribute to the booklet’s finding that Mevea has demonstrated off-road evidence, alongside a 2026 tractor paper and mining training [f8668, f9101]. Separately, the glossary describes Siemens Simcenter Prescan as commercial, with on-road-only evidence [f15898]. No public price was found for Prescan; the supplied facts therefore distinguish Siemens-linked off-road evidence for Mevea from the narrower evidence reported for Prescan [f8668, f9101, f15898].
